outcome_detail: Fifth consecutive 0.39. Ties V13 (56076685), V11 proposal_centered (56049359) and V11 gt_centered (56050554) despite being +0.006926 tune / +0.006119 audit above V13 locally, and +0.015879 tune above the 0.38-scoring E015 baseline.
calibration_significance: This is the point that falsifies ceiling_analysis_2026-09-07.md section 1. That document asserted a stable local->public offset of -0.050 +- 0.003 over four submissions and derived the project's target from it ('public 0.55 requires local tune PQ ~= 0.60'). Under that model V17's local 0.448703 predicted public 0.3959-0.4014. It scored 0.39. scripts/analyze_public_transfer.py shows the feasible constant-offset region across all five submissions is now EMPTY under both round-to-nearest and truncation display models, and that a slope of a=1.00 is ruled out for any affine model (feasible slopes a in [0.01, 0.87]).
